arguments.command:
# Check for API Key
if [ -z "$LEONARDO_API_KEY" ]; then
  echo "Error: LEONARDO_API_KEY environment variable is not set." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Start Generation
GENERATION_RESPONSE=$(curl --silent --request POST \
  --url https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations \
  --header 'accept: application/json' \
  --header "authorization: Bearer $LEONARDO_API_KEY" \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "prompt": "A glowing Bitcoin symbol at the center of a futuristic financial district, with streams of data and light flowing into it from surrounding skyscrapers. Professional editorial illustration, modern digital art, cinematic lighting.",
    "modelId": "7b592283-e8a7-4c5a-9ba6-d18c31f258b9",
    "num_images": 1,
    "width": 1024,
    "height": 576
  }')

GENERATION_ID=$(echo "$GENERATION_RESPONSE" | grep -o '"generationId":"[^"]*' | sed 's/"generationId":"//')

if [ -z "$GENERATION_ID" ]; then
  echo "Error: Failed to get generationId from Leonardo AI." >&2
  echo "Response: $GENERATION_RESPONSE" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Poll for completion
IMAGE_URL=""
for i in {1..12}; do
  STATUS_RESPONSE=$(curl --silent --request GET \
    --url "https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations/$GENERATION_ID" \
    --header 'accept: application/json' \
    --header "authorization: Bearer $LEONARDO_API_KEY")
  
  # Check status first
  STATUS=$(echo "$STATUS_RESPONSE" | grep -o '"status":"[^"]*' | sed 's/"status":"//')

  if [ "$STATUS" == "COMPLETE" ]; then
    IMAGE_URL=$(echo "$STATUS_RESPONSE" | grep -o '"url":"[^"]*' | sed 's/"url":"//' | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "$IMAGE_URL" ]; then
      break
    fi
  fi
  
  if [ "$STATUS" == "FAILED" ]; then
      echo "Error: Image generation failed according to API." >&2
      exit 1
  fi

  sleep 5
done

if [ -z "$IMAGE_URL" ]; then
  echo "Error: Image generation timed out after 60 seconds." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Download Image
curl -L -s -o /tmp/crypto-feature.jpg "$IMAGE_URL"

# Return path
echo "/tmp/crypto-feature.jpg"
